item.title: Logistics at Grand Harbour becoming unsustainable, operators warn

item.title: Two Fgura United players hospitalised after mid-air clash during Sunday match

item.description: Opposition Leader Alex Borg promised government the Opposition's full support to address the impacts of the Iranian crisis

item.title: WATCH | Abela keeps people guessing on general election date

item.title: Israel’s UN envoy criticises Maltese diplomat over Iran school attack statement

item.title: WATCH | Contractor pours concrete around trees and then covers it with soil
item.description: A contractor tasked with roadworks next to Bieb is-Sultan in Żabbar has poured concrete around the base of mature trees and covered it up with soil

item.title: I think we need to bring back Super Nanny
item.description: As any good nanny would tell you, actions have consequences, and it is about time we implement this adage not just at home, but nationwide
